text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the press conference for the
upcoming
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You were particularly impressive in the
Asahi Hai
F.S. How do you feel going
into the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think I'm going to have to run as
hard as I
can.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
In your last race, there were only five
runners,
correct?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, y-yes...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Some people are saying it was your
overwhelming
ability that made your
rivals avoid the race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to the Hot Rod to win a race
before it's
even started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was exhausting for some
reason.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I guess a press conference for a
Classic would
make anyone nervous.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's all good in the neighborhood!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, I would say it's about time to get
training,
but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit late to start now, so why don't
we take
the rest of the day off and go
for a drive instead?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Maruzensky and I suddenly
end up
going for a drive.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yahoooo! I love driving!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the wind and this scenery
speeding
by... I could just keep driving
forever!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer, are you listening? You
look like
you're sleeping.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer, are you listening? You
look like
you're sleeping.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a touch more speed will wake
you up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I guess I got a little carried
away. How
far have we been driving?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's just so fun to burn rubber in Tata!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to see how much Maruzensky
enjoys
driving her beloved car, but
something feels off...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You really can read me like a
book.
choice_data_list: Isn't running in a race fun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But, yeah...
I've been having a little less
of a good
time with racing recently.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun when I first debuted.

Competing with everyone at full speed
and all
that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For the first time, I was so immersed in
running
that there were days I'd even
forget to go for a
drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But while I was enjoying myself, the
others were
running for completely
different reasons...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, right? How pained that
poor girl
looked when she said she
wanted to avoid racing
against me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You saw it too, right? How pained that
poor girl
looked when she said she
wanted to avoid racing
against me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I'm left with almost no one to
run with.
Where's the fun to be had in
that?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know I shouldn't say this right before
the
Classics...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But maybe it's better if I don't run...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not run? I'm sure she was feeling the
same way in
the previous race too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it's also true that I became her
trainer
because of her fantastic running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Backwards? Are you saying it's better if I do run?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But everyone's been avoiding races
because of
me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean Tata?
choice_data_list: What do you like most about your ride?
What do you like most about your ride?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I like her overwhelming speed and
acceleration, and the way driving her
makes me feel like I'm
becoming one
with the wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She has thrills you can't experience in an
ordinary
car.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I run like Tata?
choice_data_list: It's the same with your running.
Your running is the same way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What is it?!
choice_data_list: There's something I want you to se...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, what is it you want to show me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Oh, someone's still running at this
hour.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's a new record, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really?! Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully I can make my debut soon if I
keep
improving at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become an Umamusume to
rival
Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Rival her? I want to surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Okay, would you time me next?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sure! Let's see some hustle out there,
Grass!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Those kids...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some may be intimidated by
Maruzensky, but
them?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Is that why they're up this late?
choice_data_list: I'm running because I want to catc...
I run because I want to catch up t...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt that Maruzensky has
had a
positive effect on the younger
students.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list: Let's show them a run that makes e...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, get everyone to run after me,
huh... You
really are something else,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, get everyone to run after me,
huh... You
really are something else,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It still feels a little strange to see how
much they
look up to me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But it is nice to know that everyone
wants to
catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I trust you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I trust you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show everyone such
amazing racing
that they'll have no
choice but to come for me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll go for it full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Maruzensky's determination
restored, she's
ready to tackle the
Satsuki Sho.
